requires_external_validation.scope: Preserve common output verification and contraction rejection; park candidate performance refinement until a concrete new information/access or cyclic-graph operation can beat positive graph transformation under the same output, source model, precision and complete charged cost. Acquire separate physical/basin/tail information before any corresponding claim.
